struct Rectangle {
    width: i32,
    height: i32,
}

impl Rectangle {
    fn area(&self) -> i32 {
        if self.width > 0 && self.height > 0 {
            self.width * self.height
        } else {
            0
        }
    }

    fn classify(&self, score: i32) -> i32 {
        if score > 90 {
            3
        } else if score > 50 {
            2
        } else {
            1
        }
    }

    fn pick(&self, x: i32) -> i32 {
        match x {
            0 => 10,
            1 => 11,
            _ => -1,
        }
    }

    fn loop_it(&self, n: i32) -> i32 {
        let mut total = 0;
        for i in 0..n {
            if i % 2 == 0 || i % 3 == 0 {
                total += i;
            }
        }
        while total > 100 && n > 0 {
            total -= n;
        }
        total
    }
}

fn longest<'a>(x: &'a str, y: &'a str) -> &'a str {
    if x.len() > y.len() {
        x
    } else {
        y
    }
}

fn try_something(n: i32) -> Result<i32, String> {
    if n < 0 {
        return Err(String::from("negative"));
    }
    Ok(n)
}
